blocks.text: Ateneo de Manila University’s fourth-year BS Restaurant Entrepreneurship seniors from the John Gokongwei School of Management are bringing their culinary concepts to life through One World Deliman, a two-day restaurant takeover at One World Deli (OWD) in Timog on November 27–28, 2026. Led by CEO Kelsey Lopez, One World Deliman is a student-led group that brings together different food concepts, showcasing the creativity, skills, and entrepreneurial experience of its members. In line with One World Deli’s focus on healthy eating, the takeover brings together food concepts that celebrate wholesome ingredients, balanced meals, and flavorful dishes.
